[[File:Andy Talaga (community card).jpg|thumb|right|220px|Andy Talaga, from the community card ''Andy T''.]]
'''Andy Talaga''' (GEMP handle '''andytalaga''')<ref name="cc1" /> played the [[2026 Retro U.S. Nationals]].<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-07-retro-u-s-nationals-prem-to-dsii-new-brunswick-new-jersey-aug-1-2026/ 2026 Retro U.S. Nationals] (preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012175621/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-07-retro-u-s-nationals-prem-to-dsii-new-brunswick-new-jersey-aug-1-2026.html Internet Archive]), starwarsccg.org</ref> He organized the [[2025 Retro Invitational Player's Ball]].<ref name="ri25">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86095 2025 Retro Invitational Player's Ball], andytalaga1, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 October 2025). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152206/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86095.html Internet Archive]</ref> He won the [[2025 Scavenger Superbowl Showcase]].<ref name="ssb25" />

== Community card ==
Andy Talaga appears on the community card ''Andy T'' (2025 Advocate Award), which lists his GEMP handle andytalaga.<ref name="cc1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Communitycards/Series%20Three/Andy%20T.jpg ''Andy T'' (2025 Advocate Award)], [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Communitycard.html SWCCG Community Awards], res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012175841/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Communitycards/Series%20Three/Andy%20T.jpg Internet Archive]</ref>
<gallery>
File:Community card Andy T 2025 Advocate Award.jpg|''Andy T'' (2025 Advocate Award)
</gallery>

== Collecting ==
Talaga's collection includes Decipher holiday cards, the 1995 ''Experience the Force'' pamphlet, convention velcro display cards and Cartamundi proof sheets.<ref name="talaga-weird">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4dR5MIPH4h4 Star Wars CCG - Most Interesting and Strangest Things in Our Collections with Special Guest Andy], [[BoardMatt]] with [[Andy Talaga]] (29 May 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20220529152129/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4dR5MIPH4h4 Internet Archive]; [https://archive.org/details/youtube-4dR5MIPH4h4 Internet Archive item].</ref>
